title: The Nature of Angels
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Angels are personal spiritual beings with intelligence, will, strength, and service before God. They are mighty servants, but they remain creatures under the command of the Lord.
summary: Angels are personal spiritual beings with intelligence, will, strength, and service before God. They are mighty servants, but they remain creatures under the command of the Lord.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is above every angelic being. Angels serve Him, worship Him, and carry out God’s purposes around His redemptive work.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Angels are not human beings who have died, nor are they divine powers. Scripture presents them as spiritual servants created by God, distinct from humanity and subject to God’s will.

Angels have personal qualities. They speak, worship, obey, rejoice, announce, warn, and carry out judgment. They are not vague energies or symbols, but real created servants before the Lord.

Angels are mighty, but their strength is delegated. They do not act independently from God’s authority, and they are never to become objects of worship, prayer, or spiritual dependence.

The nature of angels should increase awe toward God. If His servants are glorious and powerful, how much greater is the Lord who made and commands them.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Confusion about angels can lead to sentimental myths, fear, or unbiblical devotion. Scripture gives believers a sober view that honors angels as God’s servants without allowing them to replace God.

This doctrine also keeps the focus on Christ. Angels are real, but they are not redeemers, mediators, or objects of faith. Jesus alone saves, rules, and receives worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive Scripture’s teaching about angels with humility. Do not build doctrine from imagination, tradition, or popular stories. Let the reality of angelic servants lead you to greater worship of God and deeper confidence in Christ’s supremacy.
